title: Chishamiso cheUchapupu Husina Kunyarara
intro: Unosangana nenyaya yakafukidzwa nechifananidzo chekupindira kwaMwari. Nyaya yekupa zvinhu zvinoshamisa uye dziviriro isina kutaura inodzokorora kuburikidza nenguva. Unogona here kuziva kuti ndiani akatarisana nemuedzo uyu unoshamisa?
clues: Vanhu vangu vakabvunza kuchena kwangu pandakadzoka nemwana
Ndakarayirwa kuti nditsanye kwenguva yakati ndisati ndataura
Chitubu chemvura nemadhirezi zvakanditsigira panguva yekutongwa kwangu
Ishe wangu vakaita kuti muti uzununguswe zvinoshamisa kuti undipe zvekudya
Ngirozi yakaonekwa kwandiri iri muchimiro chemunhu akakwana

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko

trial.answer: Kubereka ari ega pasi pemuti wemuchindwe

outcome.answer: Kusava nemhosva kwangu kwakaratidzwa apo mwanakomana wangu mucheche akataura

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
